vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an owner-only function setBlacklist that can blacklist any address. The vulnerability is that the owner can arbitrarily blacklist addresses, which could be abused to block certain users from transferring tokens. To exploit this, we need to become the owner (or impersonate them) and call setBlacklist on our address to make isBlacklist[attacker] == true.
attack_strategy: 1. Read the current owner address from the contract's storage. 2. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank(). 3. Call setBlacklist(attacker, true) to blacklist our address. 4. Verify that isBlacklist[attacker] is now true.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the owner address by reading the _owner storage slot (slot 0 in Ownable). 2. Start impersonating the owner with vm.startPrank(owner). 3. Call TARGET.setBlacklist(attacker, true). 4. Stop impersonation. 5. Verify that TARGET.isBlacklist(attacker) returns true.
